hook: Google's Gemini 4 Argon scored 99.4 points to beat Meta's 94.2.

sections.voiceover: Google's Gemini 4 Argon scored 99.4 points to beat Meta's 94.2.
sections.visual_cue: Split frame displaying Google Gemini 4 Argon score of 99.4 alongside Meta Muse Spark Open score of 94.2.

sections.voiceover: On October 13, 2026, Google launched Gemini 4 Argon. Meta responded on October 15, 2026, releasing Muse Spark Open. Where did Meta's model rank against rating 1645?
sections.visual_cue: Timeline marking release dates of October 13, 2026 for Gemini 4 Argon and October 15, 2026 for Muse Spark Open.

sections.voiceover: Except Meta's model clocked in at 7.4 seconds per sample.
sections.visual_cue: Digital stopwatch metric displaying 7.4 seconds speed test result.

sections.voiceover: Vision speed favored Meta at 7.4 seconds versus 13.4 seconds. Yet Gemini 4 Argon captured rank 4 with a rating of 1645. Meta settled for rank 10 with a score of 1517.
sections.visual_cue: Horizontal bar chart comparing 7.4 seconds against 13.4 seconds, followed by leaderboard rows showing rank 4 rating 1645 and rank 10 rating 1517.

sections.voiceover: Google's 99.4 aggregate score secured the ultimate victory.
sections.visual_cue: Final scoreboard graphic emphasizing 99.4 aggregate score.
